name: ShuratCode-skills
description: Shaked Eyal's personal skills for Claude Code and Claude Desktop (Cowork).

plugins.name: fresh-review
plugins.description: Fresh-eyes code review with enforced producer/reviewer context separation, a shared diff packet, an opt-in cross-model Codex pass (--codex), per-run logging, and — when the subject has a PR — static-analysis follow-through checks (Wiz/Snyk/CodeQL) plus producer-side triage against the PR discussion; a lean PR mode explains the change with a rendered diagram, one paragraph, verdict, and comments.

plugins.name: upgrade-all
plugins.description: One-shot local maintenance: Homebrew, gstack, and Claude Code plugin updates.

plugins.name: pull-all
plugins.description: Recursively fast-forward the main branch of every git repo under a path.

plugins.name: restaurant-search
plugins.description: Find restaurants that are verifiably open and verifiably serve a qualifying dish.

plugins.name: vault-tools
plugins.description: Route, ingest, query, lint, book-digest, book-note, and podcast operations for an LLM-maintained Obsidian second-brain vault, each deferring to the vault's AGENTS.md.

plugins.name: second-brain
plugins.description: Ingest, query, lint, book-note, book-digest, podcast, watch, and sweep operations for an LLM-maintained Notion second brain, each running a workspace guard and deferring to the workspace's Agent Handbook.

plugins.name: worktree-cleanup
plugins.description: Safely clean up git worktrees: dry-run classification, then delete only user-approved ones, never those with uncommitted changes or unpublished commits.

plugins.name: everything
plugins.description: Meta-plugin: installs every ShuratCode skill and its dependencies.
